01

“and indeed we are all alert [hadhirun]”

An explanation transmitted from al-Aswad ibn Yazīd (Q 26:56).

742
Explanation from al-Aswad ibn Yazīd No. 742: 1: 7

al-Aswad ibn Yazīd

English
Transmission wording
742: 1:7. Sufyan, from Abu Ishaq, from al-Aswad ibn Yazid, that he recited it
"and indeed we are all alert [hadhirun]": He said, armed and equipped (verse 56).
العربية
742: 1: 7 سفيان عن أبي إسحق عَنِ الْأَسْوَدِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ أَنَّهُ قرأها وإنا لجميع حاذرون قال مودون مقوون (الآية 56) .

02

“except one who comes to God with a sound heart”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 26:89).

743
Explanation from Mujāhid No. 743: 2: 8

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
743: 2:8. Sufyan, from Layth, from Mujahid, on His words
"except one who comes to God with a sound heart": He said, there is no doubt in you (verse 89).
العربية
743: 2: 8 سُفْيَانُ عَنْ لَيْثٍ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ في قوله مَنْ أَتَى اللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ قال ليس فيك شك (الآية 89) .

English

04

“carving out of the mountains houses, skillfully [farihin]”

An explanation transmitted from Abd Allah ibn Shaddad (Q 26:149).

745
Explanation from Abd Allah ibn Shaddad No. 745: 4: 18

Abd Allah ibn Shaddad

English
Transmission wording
745: 4:18. Sufyan, from al-Suddi, from Abd Allah ibn Shaddad, on His words
"carving out of the mountains houses, skillfully [farihin]": He said, you act arrogantly [the following word is unclear] (verse 149).
العربية
745: 4: 18 سفيان عَنِ السُّدِّيِّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بن شداد في قوله من الجبال بيوتا فرهين قال تتجبرون حديث (الآية 149) .

al-Ḥasan

English

06

“those who prostrate”

Three explanations transmitted from ʿIkrima and Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 26:219).

747
Explanation from ʿIkrima No. 747: 6: 2

ʿIkrima

English
Transmission wording
747: 6:2. Sufyan related to us, from his father, from Ikrima, on
"those who prostrate": He said, his standing, his bowing, and his prostration (verse 219).
العربية
747: 6: 2 حدثنا سفيان عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ فِي الساجدين قال قيامه وركوعه وسجوده (الآية 219) .
Edition record 371469 · p. 230Link to report ↗
748
Report No. 748: 7: 3

Report 748

English
748: 7:3. Sufyan related to us, from Ali ibn Badhima, from Ikrima, the same.
العربية
748: 7: 3 حدثنا سفيان عن علي بن بذئمة عند عن عكرمة مثله.

749
Report from Mujāhid No. 749: 8: 4

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
749: 8:4. Sufyan, from Layth, from Mujahid, on

08

“except those who believe and do righteous deeds and remember God…”

An explanation transmitted from Khusayf or another (Q 26:227).

751
Explanation from Khusayf or another No. 751: 10: 5

Khusayf or another

English
Transmission wording
751: 10:5. Sufyan, from Khusayf or another, on His words
"except those who believe and do righteous deeds and remember God often and defend themselves after being wronged": He said, it was revealed about ⦗p. 231⦘ Abd Allah ibn Rawaha and his support of the Prophet, peace be upon him, with his tongue (verse 227).

الإسناد
751: 10: 5 سفيان عَنْ خُصَيْفٍ أَوْ غَيْرِهِ فِي قوله الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَذَكَرُوا اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا وَانْتَصَرُوا مِنْ بَعْدِ ما ظلموا قَالَ نَزَلَتْ فِي
